label: The M-1 cache writes into .skilled/, a repository-specific brand directory, in a mode meant for any codebase: the documented path is .skilled/.code-review-cache/<repo-ref>.jsonl (SKILL.md:491, pr-state-dedup.md:41, README.md:137), so reviewing a foreign repository creates a .skilled/ directory at that repository's root as the cache's host. The rationale section explains the hidden cache but not the brand directory. Reproducing case: run any full review with M-1 enabled against a repo without .skilled/; the documented write path creates one. NEW P2.

Two documents each claim to be the source of truth for the deep-review taxonomy and neither points at the other's authority: review-core.md calls itself 'shared doctrine consumed by both @review and @deep-review' while quick-reference.md sends readers to system-deep-loop/deep-review/assets/review-mode-contract.yaml as the canonical review-mode contract manifest. The contract is a real 488-line manifest with its own severity math and evidence rule (contract yaml line 121), and no reconciliation rule exists for disagreements such as the finding fields. Reproducing case: rg -n 'source of truth|canonical' over the review references prints the quick-reference row while review-core.md carries the other claim. NEW P2. The contract's file:line-only evidence rule versus the review case field is phase 009 in-flight scope and was not evaluated.

The mode uses two near-identical status vocabularies and only one is machine-parsed: review-ux-single-pass.md:64 tells the reviewer to include APPROVE, REQUEST_CHANGES or COMMENT after the findings (the summary block tokens at SKILL.md:337), while the mandatory final line uses APPROVED, REQUESTED_CHANGES and COMMENTED (SKILL.md:369) and downstream automation exact-matches it (SKILL.md:398). Observed reproduction: a scratch review ending 'Review status: APPROVE' produced 'FAIL: final line is not an exact status line' with exit 1 from check-review-final-line.js. NEW P2.

Verified agreement across the review references and the SKILL contract: case field (review-core.md:97 vs SKILL.md:345), cross-group id (94 vs 311), workload note (99), precedence rules (71 vs 107), and the M-1 signature and skip text (pr-state-dedup.md:22 vs SKILL.md:485) all match. ALREADY-ADOPTED, no action.
